name: world-war
description: World War — Telegram multiplayer strategy game (Cloudflare Workers + D1 + Hono + React, 100% free tier)

scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config apps/worker/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config apps/worker/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:studio: wrangler d1 execute DB --local --command "SELECT id, name, treasury FROM nations LIMIT 10" --config apps/worker/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy --config apps/worker/wrangler.jsonc
